options.label: Document the key architectural decisions and trade-offs
options.description: For each major design decision in the current architecture, state: (a) what you chose, (b) what you rejected, (c) why. Trade-off documentation now prevents expensive reversals later.

options.label: Identify the constraints that shape the architecture
options.description: List the non-negotiable constraints: latency requirements, throughput targets, deployment environment, team size, operational complexity ceiling. Architecture decisions should be traceable to these.

options.label: Define the failure modes and how the system handles them
options.description: For the critical paths in your current design, enumerate the failure modes — network partition, DB unavailability, downstream API timeouts. State explicitly how each is handled or why it's acceptable to not handle it.
